title: game_seq nondeterministic at game end due to GAME_OVER callback race
description:
The final pass_priority at game end reads game_seq from lastGameView, but the value depends on whether GAME_OVER callback has fired before passPriority's game-over bail-out. If GAME_OVER hasn't arrived yet, lastGameView contains a stale game_seq from the last actionable callback. This causes the dark_depths_combo golden test to flake with game_seq fluctuating between 91 and 97.

Root cause: handleGameOver() updates lastGameView with the authoritative final game state, but passPriority's game-over check (activeGames.isEmpty() && gameEverStarted) can trigger before GAME_OVER arrives, reading a stale lastGameView.

Fix: Either make passPriority's game-over bail-out wait for GAME_OVER to update lastGameView, or have the bail-out path read game_seq from a source that doesn't depend on callback timing (e.g., the last PendingAction's gameSeq).
